Inspect fuel-bounded recursive traversals in this Bend 2 declaration. When a result promises complete parsing, traversal, construction, or search, exhausting Nat fuel before the input is consumed is an explicit failure or partial result, or a stated bound covers every recursive step. Silently substituting an empty tree, missing node, truncated token stream, or successful partial parse breaks this rule. For a split n/2 and n-n/2, the larger child and the leaf step count toward the depth bound. An intentionally bounded approximation with explicit partial status is allowed. If no such traversal exists, this rule holds.
